title: 12 Days, 50-Hour Aerial Yoga Teacher Training Course in Bali, Indonesia
metaTitle: Best Aerial Yoga Teacher Training in Bali | 50-Hour Course
metaDescription: Join our 12-day, 50-hour Aerial Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. Learn hammock techniques, anatomy, sequencing, inversions, and teaching skills in Ubud.
summary: A 12-day, 50-hour aerial yoga teacher training in Ubud covering hammock techniques, anatomy, sequencing, inversions and teaching skills.
intro: This aerial yoga teacher training course is designed to provide the student with a solid foundation in the practice by providing hands-on training, understanding of the basics of anatomy, and yogic philosophy throughout the 12 days. Throughout the course, flexibility, strength, balance, body awareness and confidence will be developed and safe and effective use of the hammock will be learned.
It's not necessary to have years of yoga practice to begin.

The fabric feels soft to the skin, but strong enough to support the weight of the practitioner. The hammock is adjusted before each session to ensure that everyone can train comfortably and safely at their level of ability and experience, irrespective of body type.

You'll learn aerial techniques, anatomy, how to design lessons and engage with students, stay safe, and perform actual lessons, so you have all the tools you need to walk into teaching with a sense of confidence and competence.

curriculum.title: Warm-Up
curriculum.summary: Class begins with gentle stretches, breathing exercises and a light warm up to prepare the body to work safely and comfortably with aerial movements.

curriculum.title: Hammock Set-Up
curriculum.summary: Students arrange their own hammock to their own body level, with instructors available at all times to assist in setting it up the right way and securely before practice.

curriculum.title: Guided Postures and Flows
curriculum.summary: Teacher chooses and sequences poses and flows specifically for aerial practice, designed to build progressively throughout the session.

curriculum.title: Aerial Inversions
curriculum.summary: Students work on partial and full inversions.

curriculum.title: Deep Stretching
curriculum.summary: Students use the hammock to make movements that they wouldn't be able to make on the floor.

curriculum.title: Savasana and Relaxation
curriculum.summary: The class ends in Savasana in the hammock, the body supported by the fabric.
